evals.prompt: Transcribe this 45-minute product strategy meeting recording. The file is at C:\temp\strategy-meeting-2026-03-01.mp3
evals.expected_output: A timestamped Markdown transcript file named transcript-<timestamp>.md
expectations: Output checks for transcription tool availability before proceeding
Output offers install-requirements.ps1 if no engine is found
Output runs scripts/transcribe.py with the audio file
Output produces a Markdown transcript with metadata and [MM:SS -> MM:SS] timestamped segments
Output does not generate a summary, minutes, or action items

evals.prompt: Transcribe interview-customer-acme-2026-02-28.m4a with the small model and save it to .\out
evals.expected_output: Transcript written to .\out using the small model
expectations: Output passes --model small and --output-dir .\out to transcribe.py
Output reports the transcript path, detected language, and segment count
Output suggests the transcript-summary skill for summaries instead of producing one
Output does not invoke any external LLM CLI
